mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, icon, cover_color, project_id, group_id, creator_id, is_template, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM `bitable_bases` WHERE creator_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT b.id, b.name, b.description, b.icon, b.cover_color, b.project_id, b.group_id, b.creator_id, b.is_template, b.sort_order, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM `bitable_bases` b INNER JOIN `bitable_base_members` m ON m.base_id = b.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND b.deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY b.sort_order ASC, b.created_at DESC

SELECT b.id, b.name, b.description, b.icon, b.cover_color, b.project_id, b.group_id, b.creator_id, b.is_template, b.sort_order, b.created_at, b.updated_at, COUNT(t.id) AS table_count FROM `bitable_bases` b LEFT JOIN `bitable_tables` t ON t.base_id = b.id AND t.deleted_at = 0 WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.deleted_at = 0 GROUP BY b.id
